name: Franklin County Ohio domestic court corruption exposé websites

mentions.name: Franklin County Ohio domestic court corruption exposé websites
mentions.description: A whistleblower/advocacy effort centered on building websites, printing signs, sending mailers, and court-watching with notes to expose alleged corruption in the Franklin County, Ohio domestic court system. It alleges judges profit from campaign-contribution kickbacks from attorneys, that sealed judgments eliminate accountability, and it seeks to get the word out about judges the author considers corrupt, particularly Judge James Brown.
mentions.problem: The domestic (family) court system in Ohio, particularly Franklin County, is described as functionally corrupt: judges allegedly receive kickbacks via campaign contributions from attorneys they rule against, all judgments are sealed with zero records or accountability, and this allegedly drives single-parent custody outcomes in most divorces.
mentions.audience: Aims to reach the general public in Ohio, particularly families and fathers affected by domestic court rulings, to spread awareness of the alleged corruption.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm blowing the whistle, working on websites, printing signs, sending out mailers, Court watching and taking notes on these corrupt evil fucks, doing anything and everything I can to get the word out that the Franklin County Ohio domestic court system in particularly has been corrupted by a small group of judges, mainly Judge James Brown.
